name: The Best Buddy
description: After dealing super effective damage, gains Attack +20%, Defense +20%, Speed +20%, and restores 2 energy.

zh.name: 最好的伙伴
zh.description: 造成克制伤害后，获得攻防速+20%，并回复2能量。

name: Power of Companions
description: For each different type of move learned, gains Attack +5% and Defense +5%. Light-type move power +20%.

zh.name: 伙伴的力量
zh.description: 每学会1个不同系别的技能，获得攻防+5%，光系技能威力+20%。

name: Oxygen Cycle
description: After using a Grass-type move, restores 10% HP.

zh.name: 氧循环
zh.description: 使用草系技能后，回复10%生命。

name: Deep Oxygen Cycle
description: After using a Grass-type move, restores 15% HP.

zh.name: 深层氧循环
zh.description: 使用草系技能后，回复15%生命。

name: Kindling
description: After using a Fire-type move, gains Attack +20%.

zh.name: 助燃
zh.description: 使用火系技能后，获得双攻+20%。

name: Detonation
description: After using a Fire-type move, permanently gains Attack +30%.

zh.name: 爆燃
zh.description: 使用火系技能后，获得双攻永久+30%。

zh.description: 使用水系技能后，全技能能耗-1。

name: Tide Surge

zh.name: 浪潮
zh.description: 使用水系技能后，全技能能耗-2。

name: Chest Out

name: King's Majesty
description: Greatly increases own base stats. When using a move with an energy cost of 1, move power +50%.

zh.name: “国王”的威严
zh.description: 自身种族值大幅增加，自己携带的能耗等于1的技能，威力+50%。

name: Shell Retraction
description: Move energy cost of carried Defense moves -2.

zh.name: 缩壳
zh.description: 携带的防御技能能耗-2。

name: Tailwind
description: When acting before the opponent, move power +50%.

zh.name: 顺风
zh.description: 若先于敌方攻击，本次技能威力+50%。

name: Skybreaker
description: When acting before the opponent, move power +75%.

zh.name: 破空
zh.description: 若先于敌方攻击，本次技能威力+75%。

name: Poison Gland
description: When using a move with an energy cost of 1 or less, the opponent gains 4 stacks of Poison.

zh.name: 毒腺
zh.description: 使用能耗小于等于1的技能时，敌方获得4层中毒。

name: Poison Mushroom
description: At the end of the turn, steals 1 energy from all jinglings on the opponent's field.

zh.name: 毒蘑菇
zh.description: 回合结束时，偷取敌方场上所有精灵1能量。

name: Compassion
description: When the opponent takes Burn damage, restores an equal amount of HP.

zh.name: 仁心
zh.description: 敌方受到灼烧伤害时，自己回复等量生命。

name: Polarization
description: Resists the type of the move equipped by this jingling. When resisting, damage taken -40%.

zh.name: 偏振
zh.description: 受到自己携带技能系别的攻击伤害-40%。

name: Complete Polarization
description: For each type of move equipped by this jingling, damage taken from that type -40%.

zh.name: 完全偏振
zh.description: 抵抗自己携带技能系别的攻击伤害。

name: Conservatism
description: When total move energy cost is less than 4, gains Defense +80%.

zh.name: 保守派
zh.description: 总技能能耗小于4时，自己获得双防+80%。

name: Focus
description: At the start of the first turn, gains Attack +100%.

zh.name: 专注力
zh.description: 入场首回合，获得物攻+100%。

name: Total Focus
description: When entering the battlefield, gains Attack +100%. After each action, loses 20% of the gained Attack.

zh.name: 全神贯注
zh.description: 入场时，获得物攻+100%，每次行动后-20%。

name: Feign Death
description: When defeated, loses 1 less Life Point.

zh.name: 诈死
zh.description: 自己力竭时，少损失1点魔力值。

name: Hoarding
description: For each energy this jingling has, gains Defense +10%.

zh.name: 囤积
zh.description: 自身每有1能量，获得双防+10%。

name: Startled
description: Jinglings that have 0 energy cannot deal damage to this jingling.

zh.name: 惊吓
zh.description: 能量等于0的精灵无法对自己造成伤害。

name: Dissolving Diffusion
description: For each Poison-type move this jingling carries, Water-type moves inflict 1 stack of Poison on the opponent.

zh.name: 溶解扩散
zh.description: 每携带1个毒系技能进入战斗，水系技能使敌方获得1层中毒。

name: Dissolving Corrosion
description: For each Poison-type move this jingling carries, Water-type moves inflict 2 stacks of Poison on the opponent.

zh.name: 溶解腐蚀
zh.description: 每携带1个毒系技能进入战斗，水系技能使敌方获得2层中毒。

name: Convection
description: Reverses energy cost increases and decreases; energy cost increases become decreases and vice versa.

zh.name: 对流
zh.description: 自己的能耗增加变为能耗降低；能耗降低变为能耗增加。

name: Compound Decoction
description: At the end of the turn, increases the number of times Poison Effect triggers by 1.

zh.name: 复方汤剂
zh.description: 回合结束时，中毒效果触发次数+1。

name: Cocooning
description: When this jingling takes fatal damage, it becomes immune to that instance of damage and gains 1 stack of Regression. This effect can trigger up to two times. If this jingling is in its lowest evolutionary form and takes fatal damage at any point, it will be immediately defeated.

zh.name: 化茧
zh.description: 受到致命伤害时，获得1层萌化，并免疫此次伤害。此特性最多触发两次，如果在最低形态受到致命伤害，将被直接击败。

name: Unwavering
description: The power of carried Attack-type moves that have no additional effect is increased by 30%.

zh.name: 不移
zh.description: 携带的无额外效果的攻击技能，威力+30%。

name: Pickpocket
description: Upon entering the battlefield, steals 2 energy from all of the opponent's jinglings on the field.

zh.name: 小偷小摸
zh.description: 入场时偷取敌方场上所有精灵2点能量。

name: Big Score
description: Upon entering the battlefield, steals 3 energy from all of the opponent's jinglings on the field.

zh.name: 大捞一笔
zh.description: 入场时偷取敌方场上所有精灵3点能量。

name: Blindfold Shuffle
description: At the start of each turn, the order of moves is shuffled. The move in Slot 4 gains move energy cost -4.

zh.name: 盲拧
zh.description: 回合开始时，技能顺序打乱，4号位的技能能耗-4。

name: Alkaloids
description: When using Grass-type moves, the opponent gains 2 stacks of Poison.

zh.name: 生物碱
zh.description: 使用草系技能时，敌方获得2层中毒。

name: High-Concentration Alkaloids
description: When using any move, the opponent gains 2 stacks of Poison.

zh.name: 高浓生物碱
zh.description: 使用技能时，敌方获得2层中毒。

name: Quick Charge
description: Restores 10 energy when this jingling triggers Leave Field.

zh.name: 快充
zh.description: 离场时回复10能量。

name: Bravery
description: Moves that this jingling carries with an energy cost greater than 3 gain move power +40%.

zh.name: 勇敢
zh.description: 自身携带的能耗大于3的技能，威力+40%。

name: Humus Cycle
description: Each time this jingling restores 1 energy, restore 5% HP.

zh.name: 腐植循环
zh.description: 每回复1能量，同时回复5%生命。

name: Floral Sprite
description: At the end of each turn, the allied team gains 1 random Devotion enhancement.

zh.name: 花精灵
zh.description: 回合结束时，己方队伍获得1次随机奉献。

name: Slow Starter
description: Initial energy is 0. Before entering the battlefield, gains 5 energy for each successful Counter by other teammates.

zh.name: 慢热型
zh.description: 初始能量为0，入场前己方精灵每成功应对1次，回复5能量。

name: Nightmare
description: After an opponent triggers Leave Field, the next jingling to enter loses 3 energy.

zh.name: 做噩梦
zh.description: 敌方精灵离场后，更换入场的精灵失去3能量。

name: Barrel Trick
description: After this jingling triggers Leave Field, the next teammate to enter the battlefield appears in Barrel Status.

zh.name: 木桶戏法
zh.description: 离场后，更换入场的精灵以木桶状态登场。

name: Courage Boost
description: If there is a Bug-type jingling in the team, this jingling gains Attack +50%.

zh.name: 壮胆
zh.description: 队伍存在虫系精灵，自己获得双攻+50%。

name: Rarebeast Blossom
description: Gains different effects upon entering the battlefield based on its legacy type. Normal Legacy Type: gains Move Power +30; Grass Legacy Type: Restore 20% HP; Fire Legacy Type: Opponent gains 6 stacks of Burn; Water Legacy Type: Move Energy Cost -2; Light Legacy Type: Gains Magic Attack +80%; Ground Legacy Type: Opponent gains Speed -60 and Combo Count -3; Ice Legacy Type: Opponent gains 2 stacks of Freeze; Dragon Legacy Type: Opponent gains Magic Defense -80%; Electric Legacy Type: Speed +80; Poison Legacy: Type Opponent gains 3 stacks of Poison; Bug Legacy Type: Opponent gains Physical Defense -70%; Fighting Legacy Type: Physical Attack +80%; Wing Legacy Type: Combo Count +2; Cute Legacy Type: Opponent gains Attack -60%; Ghost Legacy Type: Opponent loses 3 energy; Dark Legacy Type: Gains 50% Lifesteal; Mechanical Legacy Type: Defense +60%; Illusion Legacy Type: Opponent gains 2 stacks of Starfall Mark.

zh.name: 稀兽花宝
zh.description: 根据自己的血脉，入场时获得不同效果。

name: Electric Surge
description: Carried Attack-type moves gain Burst: power +40.

zh.name: 电流刺激

description: For each other Bug-type jingling in the team, this jingling gains Attack +10%, Defense +10%, and Speed +10% upon entering the battlefield.

zh.name: 虫群鼓舞
zh.description: 队伍中每有1只其他的虫系精灵，自己入场时获得攻防速+10%。

name: Swarm Assault
description: For each other Bug-type jingling in the team, this jingling gains Attack +15%, Defense +15%, and Speed +15% upon entering the battlefield.

zh.name: 虫群突袭
zh.description: 队伍中每有1只其他的虫系精灵，自己入场时获得攻防速+15%。

name: Chestnut Shell
description: When attacked, inflicts 1 stack of Spike Mark on the opponent.

zh.name: 栗子壳
zh.description: 被攻击时，赋予敌方一层棘刺印记。

name: Scapegoat
description: For each 25% HP lost, gains Combo Count +2.

zh.name: 嫁祸
zh.description: 自己每失去25%生命，连击数+2。

name: Clean Freak

zh.name: 洁癖
zh.description: 离场后，自己的增益和减益会被更换入场的精灵继承。

name: Greed
description: After the opponent triggers Leave Field, the next jingling to enter inherits the opponent's Buffs and Debuffs.

zh.name: 贪婪

name: Hydro Wing Boost

zh.name: 渴求

name: Free Drift

zh.name: 自由飘
zh.description: 自己每有1层萌化，获得连击数+2。

name: Quick Hammer

zh.name: 快锤
zh.description: 携带的能耗小于3的技能，获得迅捷。

name: Bait and Claim

zh.name: 碰瓷
zh.description: 自己使用恶系技能后，敌方失去2能量。

zh.name: 地脉馈赠
zh.description: 突破能量上限并立即回复10能量，入场前己方精灵每放1次地系技能，回复3点能量。

name: Stone Feast
description: When energy is insufficient, consumes 5% of HP to replace 1 energy.

zh.name: 石头大餐
zh.description: 能量不足时，消耗5%生命，代替1能量。

name: Mercy

zh.name: 悲悯
zh.description: 己方队伍中每有1只力竭的精灵，自己获得双攻+30%。

name: Mourning

zh.name: 悼亡
zh.description: 双方队伍中每有1只力竭的精灵，自己获得双攻+30%。

name: Stargazing
description: For each stack of Starfall Mark on the opponent, this jingling's Ground-type move power +20%.

zh.name: 观星
zh.description: 敌方每有1层星陨印记，自己的地系技能威力+20%。

name: Starfall
description: For each stack of Starfall Mark on the opponent, this jingling's move power +20%.

zh.name: 坠星

name: Blind Obedience

zh.name: 盲从
zh.description: 可以携带多个随机技能类技能（包括借用，复写，取念），非幻系技能能耗-2。

name: Kaka Dash

zh.name: 咔咔冲刺
zh.description: 若先于敌方行动，行动后获得连击数+1。

name: Vigilance

zh.name: 警惕
zh.description: 回合结束时，若自己能量为0则脱离。

name: Gluttony

zh.name: 暴食
zh.description: 携带的龙系技能获得迅捷。

name: Contempt
description: Carried Non-Light-type moves gain move power +25%.

zh.name: 目空
zh.description: 携带的非光系技能，威力+25%。

name: Dazzle
description: Gains three additional random moves that are not currently carried, and non-Light-type moves gain move power +25%.

zh.name: 夺目
zh.description: 额外获得三个未携带的随机技能，且非光系技能威力+25%。

name: Resonance

zh.name: 共鸣

name: Carefree
description: Regression can be gained infinitely.

zh.name: 无忧无虑
zh.description: 可获得的萌化层数不受限制。

name: Underhand
description: After the opponent triggers Leave Field, the next jingling to enter gains 5 stacks of Poison.

zh.name: 下黑手
zh.description: 敌方精灵离场后，更换入场的精灵获得5层中毒。

name: Toxic Fangs
description: When the opponent is inflicted with Poison, they also receive Physical Attack -40% and Speed -40.

zh.name: 毒牙
zh.description: 使敌方获得中毒时，也会使其获得物攻-40%和速度-40。

name: Accretion Disk
description: At the end of the turn, the opponent gains 2 stacks of Starfall Mark.

zh.name: 吸积盘
zh.description: 回合结束时，敌方获得2层星陨印记。

name: Interval Training
description: After using a Fighting-type move, this jingling's Physical Attack +20% permanently, Speed -10 permanently.

zh.name: 间歇式训练
zh.description: 释放武系技能后，物攻永久提升20%，速度永久-10。

name: Snowball Fight
description: Initial energy is 0. Before entering the battlefield, for each Ice-type move used by teammates, restores 3 energy.

zh.name: 打雪仗
zh.description: 初始能量为0，入场前己方精灵每放1次冰系技能，回复3能量。

name: Icebound
description: While this jingling is on the battlefield, opponent gains Move Energy Cost +1.

zh.name: 冰封
zh.description: 自身在场时，敌方全技能能耗+1。

name: Frozen Soil
description: For each Ice-type move carried when entering battle, Ground-type move power +10%.

zh.name: 冻土

name: Mechanical Variation

zh.name: 机械变式
zh.description: 自己携带的技能每回合位置变化时，该技能能耗-1。

name: Soul Scorch

zh.name: 灵魂灼伤
zh.description: 冰系技能使敌方获得4层灼烧，火系技能使敌方获得2层冻结。

name: Hide and Seek
description: When the opponent is inflicted with Freeze, they also gain Move Energy Cost +1.

zh.name: 捉迷藏
zh.description: 使敌方获得冻结时，也会使其获得全技能能耗+1。

name: Gotcha
description: Upon entering the battlefield, inflicts 2 stacks of Freeze on the opponent. When the opponent is inflicted with Freeze, they also gain Move Energy Cost +1.

zh.name: 抓到你了
zh.description: 自己入场时敌方获得2层冻结，使敌方获得冻结时，也会使其获得全技能能耗+1。

name: Stone Balance
description: If the move energy cost used is higher than the opponent's, the opponent loses energy equal to the difference at the end of the turn.

zh.name: 石天平
zh.description: 若使用技能能耗高于敌方，回合结束敌方失去能耗之差的能量。

name: Wild Senses
description: After a successful Counter, this jingling's next action gains Priority +1.

zh.name: 野性感官
zh.description: 应对成功后，下次行动先手+1。

name: Sacred Flame Knight
description: After a successful Counter, the next Attack-type move used by this jingling deals double damage.

zh.name: 圣火骑士
zh.description: 应对成功后，下次攻击威力翻倍。

name: Shield of Thought
description: After a successful Counter, this jingling's next action's move energy cost -5.

zh.name: 思维之盾
zh.description: 应对成功后，下次行动技能能耗-5。

name: Toughness King
description: Poison Effect damage taken from the opponent heals this jingling.

zh.name: 耐活王
zh.description: 敌方受到中毒效果伤害时，自己回复等量生命。

name: Anadromous
description: Each time this jingling enters Charge state, it permanently gains Move Energy Cost -2.

zh.name: 洄游
zh.description: 每次进入蓄力状态，获得全技能能耗永久-2。

name: Bioelectricity

zh.name: 生物电
zh.description: 携带的电系技能获得迸发：能耗-2。

name: Diffuse Corrosion

zh.name: 扩散侵蚀

name: Minstrel's String
description: Marks applied do not replace other Marks, but take effect simultaneously.

zh.name: 吟游之弦
zh.description: 赋予的印记不会替换其他印记，而是同时生效。

name: Battle-Hardened
description: Each time a teammate performs a successful Counter, this jingling's Water-type move power +20% and Fighting-type move power +20% when entering the battlefield.

zh.name: 身经百练
zh.description: 己方精灵每应对1次，自己入场时水系和武系技能威力+20%。

name: Takeoff Acceleration

zh.name: 起飞加速
zh.description: 本场战斗首次使用的技能获得迅捷。

name: Snowballing
description: When inflicting Freeze on the opponent, additionally inflicts 2 stacks of Freeze.

zh.name: 加个雪球
zh.description: 使敌方获得冻结时，也会使其获得2层冻结。

name: Coral Bone
description: When the opponent triggers Leave Field, this jingling gains Move Energy Cost -3. (Cannot be dispelled)

zh.name: 珊瑚骨
zh.description: 敌方精灵离场时，自身获得全技能能耗-3。（不可被驱散）。

name: Dormitory
description: This jingling's energy can exceed the energy limit.

zh.name: 多人宿舍
zh.description: 自己的能量可以超过能量上限。

name: Tea Polyphenol
description: After this jingling triggers Leave Field, the next jingling to enter restores 20% HP and is immune to Leech.

zh.name: 茶多酚
zh.description: 离场后，更换入场的精灵回复20%生命且免疫寄生。

name: Gelatin Sheet
description: When this jingling triggers Leave Field, the next jingling to enter gains Defense +20% and is immune to Freeze.

zh.name: 吉利丁片
zh.description: 离场后，更换入场的精灵获得双防+20%且免疫冻结。

name: Maillard Reaction
description: After this jingling triggers Leave Field, the next jingling to enter gains Attack +20% and is immune to Burn.

zh.name: 美拉德反应
zh.description: 离场后，更换入场的精灵获得双攻+20%且免疫灼烧。

name: Centripetal Force
description: Moves in Slot 1 and Slot 2 gain Transmission 1 and power +30.

zh.name: 向心力
zh.description: 1号和2号位技能获得传动1和威力+30。

name: Four-Axis Machine Tool
description: If the move in Slot 4 is a move that this jingling has not used before, that move's energy cost -3.

zh.name: 四轴机床
zh.description: 若释放的4号位技能为该精灵未使用过的技能，该技能能耗-3。

name: Charge Cell
description: Each time this jingling enters the battlefield, it permanently gains Attack +30%.

zh.name: 蓄电池
zh.description: 每入场1次，永久获得双攻+30%。

name: Supercharged Cell
description: Each time this jingling enters the battlefield, it permanently gains Attack +40%.

zh.name: 超级电池
zh.description: 每入场1次，获得双攻永久+40%。

name: Overload Protection
description: This jingling triggers Exit after each action.

zh.name: 防过载保护
zh.description: 每次行动后脱离。

name: Blood Type Attraction
description: For each type of move the opponent carries, this jingling's move power +10.

zh.name: 血型吸引
zh.description: 敌方每携带1种系别的技能，自己攻击时威力+10。

name: Fair Measure
description: Upon entering the battlefield, copies the opponent's Buffs. While on the battlefield, if the opponent gains Buffs, this jingling also gains the same Buffs.

zh.name: 衡量
zh.description: 入场时，复制敌方的增益。在场时，若敌方获得增益自己也会获得。

name: Soul Chaser
description: Attack-type moves with an energy cost of 1 or less cannot damage this jingling.

zh.name: 逐魂鸟
zh.description: 能耗小于等于1的攻击技能，无法对自己造成伤害。

name: Overtone Row
description: After using a Status-type move, the opponent gains the effect of the 'Noise' move for 3 turns.

zh.name: 泛音列
zh.description: 使用状态技能后，敌方获得【聒噪】技能的效果，持续3回合。

name: Compounding Force
description: Carried moves affected by energy cost changes gain double the effect.

zh.name: 倾轧
zh.description: 携带的技能受能耗变化效果的影响翻倍。

name: Windrider Combo
description: Each time this jingling uses a Flying-type move, it gains a cumulative Combo Count +1 bonus, which applies to all of its moves.

zh.name: 乘风连击
zh.description: 自己使用翼系技能后，获得连击数+1。

name: Rally Breath
description: When using a move with an energy cost of 3, this jingling gains Attack +20% and Defense +20%.

zh.name: 鼓气
zh.description: 使用能耗为3的技能时，获得攻防+20%。

name: Full Rally
description: When using a move with an energy cost of 3, this jingling permanently gains Attack +20% and Defense +20%.

zh.name: 三鼓作气
zh.description: 使用能耗为3的技能时，获得攻防永久+20%。

name: Jealousy
description: While in Charge state, this jingling can use any of its carried moves.

zh.name: 嫉妒
zh.description: 蓄力状态下，可以使用任一携带技能。

name: Skirmish
description: While in Charge state, this jingling can use any of its carried moves, and gains Defense +100%.

zh.name: 游弋
zh.description: 蓄力时可以使用任一携带技能，且获得双防+100%。

name: Wave Breaker
description: For each Water-type move this jingling carries, Ground-type moves' energy cost -1.

zh.name: 消波块
zh.description: 每携带1个水系技能进入战斗，地系技能能耗-1。

name: Shifting Stance
description: After this jingling successfully performs Counter using an Attack-type move once, it fully restores HP and transforms into 'Chess Queen'. After transforming, its base stats and trait become those of Chess Queen, while its equipped moves remain unchanged. The Attack and Defense bonuses gained before transformation persist after transforming. Before transformation, Chess Queen’s trait can already be triggered normally, and its effects will take effect after transformation.

zh.name: 腾挪
zh.description: 自身以攻击技能应对1次后，回满状态，变身为【棋绮后】。变身后，基础种族值与特性变为棋绮后，但不改变已携带的技能。变身前获得的攻防提升效果在变身后依然保留。变身之前，棋绮后的特性可被正常触发，其效果将在变身后生效。

name: Guard Duty
description: After this jingling successfully performs Counter using a Defense-type move twice, it fully restores HP and transforms into 'Chess Queen'. After transforming, its base stats and trait become those of Chess Queen, while its equipped moves remain unchanged. The Attack and Defense bonuses gained before transformation persist after transforming. Before transformation, Chess Queen’s trait can already be triggered normally, and its effects will take effect after transformation.

zh.name: 保卫
zh.description: 自身以防御技能应对2次后，回满状态，变身为【棋绮后】。变身后，基础种族值与特性变为棋绮后，但不改变已携带的技能。变身前获得的攻防提升效果在变身后依然保留。变身之前，棋绮后的特性可被正常触发，其效果将在变身后生效。

name: Dual Omens
description: After this jingling successfully performs Counter using a Status-type move once, it fully restores HP and transforms into 'Chess Queen'. After transforming, its base stats and trait become those of Chess Queen, while its equipped moves remain unchanged. The Attack and Defense bonuses gained before transformation persist after transforming. Before transformation, Chess Queen’s trait can already be triggered normally, and its effects will take effect after transformation.

zh.name: 好象坏象
zh.description: 自身以状态技能应对1次后，回满状态，变身为【棋绮后】。变身后，基础种族值与特性变为棋绮后，但不改变已携带的技能。变身前获得的攻防提升效果在变身后依然保留。变身之前，棋绮后的特性可被正常触发，其效果将在变身后生效。

name: Penetration
description: For each time a teammate uses a Fighting-type or Ground-type move, this jingling gains Attack +5% and Defense +5% when entering the battlefield.

zh.name: 渗透
zh.description: 己方精灵每使用1次武系或地系技能，自己入场时获得攻防+5%。

name: Royal Command
description: Chess Majesty greatly increases base stats. When defeated, the player loses 4 Life Point.

zh.name: 御驾亲征
zh.description: 棋契陛下大幅提升种族值，力竭时扣除4点魔力值。

name: Sword of Justice
description: Can only use the move in Slot 1.

zh.name: 正位宝剑
zh.description: 仅可以使用1号位技能。

name: Ace of Swords
description: Can only use the moves in Slot 1 and Slot 3.

zh.name: 宝剑王牌
zh.description: 仅可使用1号和3号位技能。

name: Nutrient Bubble
description: Gains 2 more stacks of any Buffs obtained.

zh.name: 营养液泡
zh.description: 获得增益时，额外获得层数+2。

name: Inch by Inch
description: When the weather is Rain or the jingling is in a Water-type environment, this jingling gains Attack +100%.

zh.name: 得寸进尺
zh.description: 天气为雨天，或处于其他水系环境中时，获得双攻+100%。

name: On the Hour
description: At the end of the turn, if all moves are in their initial positions, moves with Transmission effect have energy cost -5.

zh.name: 整点报时
zh.description: 回合末，若所有技能都在初始位置，传动技能能耗-5。

name: Crackle!
description: For the first action after entering the battlefield, the selected move's usage count +1.

zh.name: 噼啪！
zh.description: 入场后首次行动，所选技能使用次数+1。

name: Continuous Load
description: Extends the duration of this jingling's Burst effects by 1 turn.

zh.name: 连续负荷
zh.description: 自己技能的迸发效果延长1回合。

name: Dusk Lily Chime
description: At the first time entering the battlefield, loses half of its current HP.

zh.name: 铃兰晚钟
zh.description: 首次入场时，失去自己一半的当前生命。

name: Scavenge
description: For each time the opponent uses 'Focus' move or switches jinglings, this jingling gains Magic Attack +20% upon entering the battlefield.

zh.name: 搜刮
zh.description: 敌方每使用1次【聚能】技能或更换精灵，自己入场时获得魔攻+20%。

name: Demon's Banquet
description: When this jingling actively defeats an opponent, this jingling gains Attack +50%.

zh.name: 恶魔的晚宴
zh.description: 主动击败敌方精灵时，自己获得双攻+50%。

name: Wing Axis
description: The move in Slot 1 gains Quick Entry and Transmission 1.

zh.name: 翼轴
zh.description: 1号位技能获得迅捷和传动1。

name: Directed Refinement
description: For each time a teammate uses a Defense-type move, this jingling's Mechanical-type and Ground-type moves gain move power +10% upon entering the battlefield.

zh.name: 定向精炼
zh.description: 己方精灵每使用1次防御技能，自己入场时机械系和地面系技能威力+10%。

name: Duelist
description: After each successful Counter, this jingling gains Move Power +30 permanently.

zh.name: 斗技
zh.description: 应对成功后，获得全技能威力永久+30。

name: Conductor
description: After each successful Counter, this jingling's Attack +30% permanently.

zh.name: 指挥家
zh.description: 应对成功后，永久获得双攻+30%。

name: Cindershrub
description: While this jingling is on the battlefield, all Burn effects increase instead of decrease.

zh.name: 煤渣草
zh.description: 在场时，所有灼烧的衰减变为增长。

name: Rattle Drum
description: For each time a teammate uses a Status-type move, this jingling's Poison-type and Regression-type moves gain move power +10% upon entering the battlefield.

zh.name: 拨浪鼓
zh.description: 己方精灵每使用1次状态技能，自己入场时毒系和萌系技能威力+10。

name: False Treasure Chest
description: When this jingling is defeated, the opponent gains Defense +20%.

zh.name: 虚假宝箱
zh.description: 自己力竭时，敌方获得攻防+20%。

name: Growth
description: At the end of the turn, restores 12% HP.

zh.name: 生长
zh.description: 回合结束时，回复12%生命。

name: Etching
description: At the end of the turn, converts every 2 Poison stacks on the opponent into 1 Poison Mark stack.

zh.name: 蚀刻
zh.description: 回合结束时，敌方每2层中毒转化为1层中毒印记。

name: Corrosion
description: For each Poison Effect stack on the opponent, this jingling's moves gain Combo Count +1.

zh.name: 侵蚀
zh.description: 敌方每有1层中毒效果，自己获得连击数+1。

name: Spirit Drain
description: When a teammate is defeated, upon entering the battlefield, this jingling inherits that teammate's highest stat other than Speed.

zh.name: 吸灵
zh.description: 己方精灵力竭后，入场时继承其的除速度外最高的一项属性。

name: Resilient Armor
description: For each time this jingling takes attack damage, the allied team gain 1 random Devotion enhancement.

zh.name: 坚韧铠甲
zh.description: 每受到1次攻击伤害，己方队伍获得1次随机奉献。

name: Rousing Swarmheart
description: Upon actively defeating an opponent, the allied team gains 5 random Devotion enhancements.

zh.name: 振奋虫心
zh.description: 主动击败敌方后，己方队伍获得5次随机奉献。

name: Indiscriminate Filter
description: While this jingling is on the battlefield, jinglings on both sides have Combo Count 2.

zh.name: 无差别过滤
zh.description: 在场时，所有精灵连击数固定为2。

name: Dark Current
description: Swaps HP percentage with the next jingling to enter the battlefield.

zh.name: 暗流
zh.description: 和下一只入场的精灵交换血量百分比。

name: Hang by a Thread
description: The first time this jingling takes fatal damage, it survives with 1 HP, and the opponent gains Stun for 1 turn.

zh.name: 悬一线
zh.description: 首次受到致命伤害时，保留1生命值，眩晕敌方一回合。

name: Immortality
description: Revives 4 turns after being defeated.

zh.name: 不朽
zh.description: 力竭4回合后复活。

name: Dual Lightspeed
description: While this jingling is on the battlefield, all end-of-turn effects trigger an additional time.

zh.name: 双向光速
zh.description: 在场时，所有回合结束时效果，触发次数+1。

name: Fallen
description: While this jingling is on the battlefield, end-of-turn effects do not trigger.

zh.name: 陨落
zh.description: 在场时，双方回合结束时触发的效果不会触发。

name: Premonition
description: If an opponent's move is sufficient to defeat this jingling, this jingling gains Speed +50 at the start of the turn.

zh.name: 预警
zh.description: 若敌方技能足够击败自己，回合开始时自己获得速度+50。

name: Foresight
description: If an opponent's move is sufficient to defeat this jingling, this jingling gains Speed +50 and Attack +50% at the start of the turn.

zh.name: 先知
zh.description: 若敌方技能足够击败自己，回合开始时自己获得速度+50，双攻+50%。

name: Sweep and Mop
description: At the end of the turn, dispels 1 Marks stack from the opponent. After dispelling, the allied team gains 1 random Devotion enhancement.

zh.name: 扫拖一体
zh.description: 回合结束时驱散敌方1层印记，且驱散后己方队伍获得1次随机奉献。

name: Special Cleaning Scenario
description: At the end of the turn, steals 1 Marks stack from the opponent.

zh.name: 特殊清洁场景
zh.description: 回合结束时偷取敌方1层印记。

name: Stellar Kindness
description: At the end of the turn, if a teammate on the battlefield has 0 energy, this jingling immediately switch in to replace that teammate.

zh.name: 星地善良
zh.description: 回合结束时，若场上的己方精灵能量等于0，自己立即替换此精灵。

name: Shape of Covenant
description: Grants different effects upon entering the battlefield based on the type of Gulu Ball used for capture. Normal Gulu Ball: All stats +5%; Advanced Gulu Ball: All stats +10%; King Gulu Ball: All stats +15%.

zh.name: 契约的形状
zh.description: 根据捕捉所用的咕噜球，入场时获得不同效果。普通咕噜球：全属性提升5%；高级咕噜球：全属性提升10%；国王球：全属性提升15%。

name: Gray Portrait
description: Attacks increase the opponent's existing Debuffs stacks by 3.

zh.name: 灰色肖像
zh.description: 攻击会使敌方已有的减益层数+3。

name: Morphing Living Painting
description: When attacking, for each Buffs stack on the opponent, move power +10%.

zh.name: 变形活画
zh.description: 攻击时，敌方每有1层增益，本次技能威力+10%。

name: Library Guardian
description: Upon entering the battlefield, if the player has only 1 Life Point, this jingling gains Attack +50%.

zh.name: 图书守卫者
zh.description: 入场时，若自己魔力值为1，自己获得双攻+50%。

name: Constructed Covenanter
description: Upon entering the battlefield, if the opponent has only 1 Life Point, this jingling gains Defense +50%.

zh.name: 构装契约者
zh.description: 入场时，若敌方魔力值为1，自己获得双防+50%。

name: Under the Dome
description: When using an Attack-type move, all opponent's Marks are converted to Starfall Mark.

zh.name: 穹顶之下
zh.description: 使用攻击技能时，敌方所有印记变为星陨。

name: Velvet Stardust
description: When attacking, if the opponent's legacy type is different from opponent's own types, move power +100%.

zh.name: 绒粉星光
zh.description: 攻击时，若敌方血脉是非本系的系别血脉，技能威力+100%。

name: Moonlight Judgment
description: When attacking, if the opponent has Leader legacy type, move power +100%.

zh.name: 月光审判
zh.description: 攻击时，若敌方血脉是首领血脉，技能威力+100%。

name: Price Paid to the Devil
description: When defeating an opponent, the opponent loses an additional 1 Life Point. When defeated by an opponent, this jingling loses an additional 1 Life Point.

zh.name: 付给恶魔的赎价
zh.description: 击败敌方精灵时，敌方额外损失1点魔力。被敌方精灵击败时，自己额外损失1点魔力。

name: Hurricane
description: If other Flying-type jinglings also have the same move, this jingling's moves gain Quick Entry. When defeated by an opponent, this jingling loses an additional 1 Life Point.

zh.name: 飓风
zh.description: 对本精灵的技能，若其他翼系精灵携带相同技能，则获得迅捷。被敌方精灵击败时，自己额外损失1点魔力。

name: Guardian
description: For each stack of Regression on teammates, this jingling gains Move Energy Cost -1 upon entering the battlefield.

zh.name: 守护者
zh.description: 己方其他精灵每有1层萌化，自己入场时全技能能耗-1。

name: Ice Drill
description: For each point of total energy cost of opponent's carried moves, this jingling's move power +10%.

zh.name: 冰钻
zh.description: 敌方携带技能总能耗每有1点，自己攻击时威力+10%。

name: Grapple
description: When this jingling uses an Attack-type move that includes the Counter effect, if Counter is successful that turn, restores 25% HP.

zh.name: 擒拿
zh.description: 攻击技能应对成功时，回复25%生命。

name: Horse Stance
description: When this jingling uses a Status-type move that includes the Counter effect, if Counter is successful that turn, gains 10 energy.

zh.name: 马步
zh.description: 状态技能应对成功时，获得10点能量。

name: Ukemi
description: Upon entering the battlefield, if the opponent switches jinglings this turn, this jingling gains all stats +100%.

zh.name: 受身
zh.description: 入场时，若敌方本回合换宠，全属性提升100%。

name: Supercharge
description: When in Charge state, 'Focus' changes to 'Charge Extension'.

zh.name: 超聚能
zh.description: 蓄力时，【聚能】变为【积蓄】。

name: Phylogenesis
description: When gaining energy or HP, the same amount of energy or HP is randomly distributed to the jinglings on the bench.

zh.name: 系统发育
zh.description: 获得能量或生命时，会将等量的能量或生命随机分配给场下的精灵。

name: Watchful Star
description: When Starfall Mark is triggered, only half of the stacks are consumed, but full damage is still dealt.

zh.name: 守望星
zh.description: 触发星陨时仅消耗一半层数，仍造成满层伤害。

name: Visiting Scholar
description: This jingling's Move Energy Cost +1, but it can learn all Attack-type moves.

zh.name: 留学生
zh.description: 自己全技能能耗+1，可以学习全部攻击技能。

name: Hasty
description: Each Combo inflicts 2 stacks of Burn on the opponent.

zh.name: 急性子
zh.description: 每次连击赋予敌方2层灼烧。

name: Steam Expansion
description: For each time a Fire-type move is used by a teammate, this jingling gains Move Power +10 upon entering the battlefield.

zh.name: 蒸汽膨胀
zh.description: 己方精灵每使用1次火系技能，自己入场时获得全技能威力+10。

name: Intimidation
description: When this jingling triggers Interrupt against the opponent, the interrupted move enters a 2-turn Cooldown.

zh.name: 威慑
zh.description: 打断敌方时，被打断的技能进入2回合冷却。

name: Heat Dissipation
description: Initial energy is 0. Before entering the battlefield, for each time a Fire-type move is used by a teammate, restores 3 energy.

zh.name: 散热
zh.description: 初始能量为0，入场前己方精灵每放1次火系技能，回复3能量。

name: Greedy Algorithm
description: The move in Slot 1 gains Transmission 1, and after using it, the opponent gains 6 stacks of Burn.

zh.name: 贪心算法
zh.description: 1号位技能获得传动1，且使用后使敌方获得6层灼烧。

name: Overload
description: Attack-type moves gain Burst: Opponent gains Move Energy Cost +1.

zh.name: 超负荷
zh.description: 攻击技能获得迸发：敌方获得全技能能耗+1。

name: Restless Fate
description: After using a Defense-type move, this jingling triggers Exit at the end of the turn.

zh.name: 奔波命
zh.description: 使用防御技能后，回合结束时脱离。

name: Graffiti
description: Move power +50% when not using Same-type Moves.

zh.name: 涂鸦
zh.description: 使用非本系技能时威力+50%。

name: Absolute Order
description: Damage taken from moves that are not the opponent's Same-type Moves is reduced by 50%.

zh.name: 绝对秩序
zh.description: 受到非敌方系别的技能攻击时伤害-50%。

name: Sentinel
description: At the start of the turn, if an opponent's move is sufficient to defeat this jingling, this jingling gains Speed +50 and triggers Exit after acting.

zh.name: 哨兵
zh.description: 回合开始时若敌方技能足够击败自己，自己获得速度+50，行动后脱离。

name: Crescent Ice Cream
description: When using an Attack-type move, each stack of Freeze on the opponent counts as an additional stack of Starfall Mark.

zh.name: 月牙雪糕
zh.description: 使用攻击技能时，敌方每层冻结视为1层额外星陨印记。

name: Work-Life Balance
description: On weekends, this jingling gains Attack +40%. At other times, it gains Defense +40%.

zh.name: 张弛有度
zh.description: 周末时自己获得双攻+40%，其他时间获得双防+40%。

name: Heaven's Sight
description: When attacking, if the opponent's legacy type is Corruption, move power +100%.

zh.name: 天通地明
zh.description: 攻击时，若敌方血脉是污染血脉，技能威力+100%。

name: Carnival Begins
description: While on the battlefield, random jinglings appear on the bench; these random jinglings can only be swapped in or out with this jingling. This jingling takes 25% more super effective damage.

zh.name: 狂欢开始
zh.description: 在场时，背包里会变化出随机精灵，随机精灵只能与本精灵相互更换。本精灵受到的克制伤害+25%。

name: Giant Snowball
description: After this jingling uses 2 different Ice-type moves, the opponent gains 4 stacks of Freeze, then the trait resets.

zh.name: 大雪球
zh.description: 自己使用2次不同的冰系技能后，对手获得4层冻结，随后特性重置。

name: Giant Fireball
description: After this jingling uses 2 different Fire-type moves, the next move requires no Charge, then the trait resets.

zh.name: 大火球
zh.description: 自己使用2次不同的火系技能后，下次技能无需蓄力，随后特性重置。

name: Disc Swap
description: This jingling's carried 'Sonic Bullet', 'Sonic Boom', 'Metal Sound', and 'Midnight Noise' moves gain increased power, and gain Variation: same-type moves.

zh.name: 换碟
zh.description: 自己携带的音波弹/音爆/金属噪音/午夜噪音威力提升，且获得巧变：同系别技能。

name: Cheerleader
description: If this jingling gains Regression while already in Regression state, the Regression is removed.

zh.name: 啦啦队长
zh.description: 若自己在萌化状态下再获得萌化会解除萌化。

name: Toy With
description: When this jingling would recover HP, the opponent loses an equal amount of HP instead.

zh.name: 戏耍
zh.description: 自己回复生命变为敌方扣除等量生命。

name: Flame Test
description: While this jingling is on the battlefield, decaying Burn stacks are converted into an equal number of Poison stacks.

zh.name: 焰色反应
zh.description: 在场时，衰减的灼烧变为相同层数的中毒。

name: Magic Hat
description: While this jingling is on the battlefield, moves carried by active jinglings on both sides gain Variation: same-type moves.

zh.name: 魔术帽
zh.description: 在场时，场上双方携带的技能获得巧变：同系别技能。

name: Encore
description: After using a Light-type move, this jingling triggers Re-Enter at the end of the turn.

zh.name: 安可
zh.description: 使用光系技能后，回合结束时自己返场。

name: In Sync
description: For each attribute (Type, Category, or Energy Cost) shared between this jingling's move and the opponent's move this turn, this jingling gains permanent Physical Attack +20% and Physical Defense +20% at the end of the turn.

zh.name: 合拍
zh.description: 若本回合自己与敌方使用的技能在系别/类型/能耗上每有1项相同，回合结束时获得物攻和物防永久+20%。

name: Spread Wings
description: While this jingling is on the battlefield, carried Normal-type moves become Flying-type. If acting after the opponent, this jingling takes 25% more damage.

zh.name: 展翅
zh.description: 在场时，自己携带的普通系技能变为翼系技能，若后于对手行动，自己受到的伤害+25%。
